title: Sparkly red apple
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='appleGrad' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='75%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e01b1b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a80f0f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shineGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd6d6' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd6d6' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles around the apple -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M14 30 L16.5 36.5 L23 39 L16.5 41.5 L14 48 L11.5 41.5 L5 39 L11.5 36.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 22 L88 27.5 L93.5 29.5 L88 31.5 L86 37 L84 31.5 L78.5 29.5 L84 27.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M90 68 L91.8 72.2 L96 74 L91.8 75.8 L90 80 L88.2 75.8 L84 74 L88.2 72.2 Z'/>
    <path d='M9 66 L10.6 69.6 L14.2 71.2 L10.6 72.8 L9 76.4 L7.4 72.8 L3.8 71.2 L7.4 69.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 L51.4 11 L54.4 12.4 L51.4 13.8 L50 16.8 L48.6 13.8 L45.6 12.4 L48.6 11 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#8ef2ff'>
    <path d='M26 76 L27.3 79 L30.3 80.3 L27.3 81.6 L26 84.6 L24.7 81.6 L21.7 80.3 L24.7 79 Z'/>
    <path d='M76 50 L77.3 53 L80.3 54.3 L77.3 55.6 L76 58.6 L74.7 55.6 L71.7 54.3 L74.7 53 Z'/>
  </g>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 30 C50 24 53 18 58 15' fill='none' stroke='#8a4b1f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M57 19 C66 14 76 16 78 22 C74 30 63 30 57 24 Z' fill='#3fbf4a'/>
  <path d='M60 21 C66 19 72 20 75 23' fill='none' stroke='#2e9438' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- apple body: two lobes with a dip at top -->
  <path d='M50 32
           C38 26 22 30 20 48
           C18 66 30 84 42 86
           C47 87 49 84 50 84
           C51 84 53 87 58 86
           C70 84 82 66 80 48
           C78 30 62 26 50 32 Z'
        fill='url(#appleGrad)'/>

  <!-- lighter edge shades instead of dark outline -->
  <path d='M50 33
           C39 28 25 32 23 48
           C21.5 62 31 78 41 80'
        fill='none' stroke='#ff8f8f' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 33
           C61 28 75 32 77 48
           C78.5 62 69 78 59 80'
        fill='none' stroke='#ff8f8f' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- glossy highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='44' rx='9' ry='12' fill='url(#shineGrad)' transform='rotate(-20 34 44)'/>

  <!-- little dimple shading at the top dip -->
  <path d='M42 34 Q50 40 58 34' fill='none' stroke='#c01616' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
